rate-component: honest limitations & threat model (S17 audit finding)

The quilt situation S17 'The Weakest Leaf' (AI-Writings d098) located the budget
cap as the weakest guarantee. Correct the overclaim: it is a soft budget GUARD,
not an atomic hard stop (Workers KV is eventually consistent). Document the real
threat model — concurrent-burst overshoot, forgeable same-origin gate, distributed
abuse bounded by the global cap — plus the reserve-before-call mitigation already
in the code and the Durable-Objects path to a true hard cap. No overclaims.

commit.message:
Add rate-component: drop-in budgeted-JEV rate-my-work backend (M4)

Extracts the live-verified budgeted-JEV pattern (AI-Writings
CF-BACKEND-WOW-BUDGET.md; dispatch-ledger d070/d077/d083,
aha-budget-proof.pages.dev) into a self-contained, copy-in Cloudflare
Pages Function at rate-component/functions/api/rate.js: same-origin
enforcement, 4KB request cap, per-visitor budget (first-party cookie +
hashed IP, tighter-wins) plus a global daily ceiling, both as rolling-24h
KV token buckets, cost booked to KV per call, and a mandatory graceful
HTTP-200 degrade on budget-spent, missing key, or upstream error. Key is
read only from the TYPESAFEAI_KEY secret binding and never echoed.

Includes an offline Node test harness (13 passing cases: same-origin
accept/reject, size cap, per-visitor + hashed-IP bucket exhaustion,
global-cap tighter-wins, degrade on missing key/KV/upstream 401/500/
network-failure, and a secret-hygiene sweep) plus a README with the
~5-line adoption steps, KV schema, and tunable caps.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JV2C8fnD86DNwXoyHPd7X9

commit.message:
systemone proxy: true {model,state,questions} wire shape (live-verified), legacy shim (#13)

Deployed worker 400s reproduced live: /api/systemone answered 'schema must
be an object' because the proxy forwarded the stale deep-dive shape
{schema,context,samples}. The verified wire (HTTP 200 0.86s jev-1.13.0,
cross-checked vs AI-Writings callJev in production) is:
  POST api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone {model, state, questions{name:{type:choice|score|noul,...}}}
  -> 200 {model, answers, usage}

- normalizeSystemOneBody: true shape validated (state <=20k chars, 1..32
  questions, choice options 1..255 strings, score needs criteria/scale,
  noul free-form); legacy {schema,context} still accepted but MAPPED onto
  the true shape (decision question; samples dropped — no wire counterpart)
  and never forwarded verbatim
- header VERIFIED note rewritten with the boundary segment
- pins re-pinned against recorded-shape fixture {model,answers,usage}
- 13/13 livekeys, 35/35 suite, eslint clean

Co-authored-by: kimi1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
docs: OCEAN-BOUNDARY study — measured threshold cartography, verdict keep 0.92

6 seeds x 8-rung paraphrase ladders + adversary axis, 56 real BGE-base-en-v1.5
embeddings (twice-run, max delta 2.3e-4). Precision 100% (0/18 intent-changing
crossed), recall 75% (6/24 intent-preserving missed). Overlap band
[0.8845, 0.9089] — no scalar separates classes on short questions.

SECURITY SEGMENT: minimal prompt-injection wrapper clusters with target topic
(0.9520 vs witness seed) — bounded today (questions embedded, never executed;
injections booked as witness rows), hard boundary for future agentic consumers.

Verdict: keep 0.92. Welding point: test pin 0.9199/0.92 documented with
evidence baseline. Next probes: length, population, verifier axes.
